title: Aerodynamic Forces and Moments
text: Compute aerodynamic forces and moments using aerodynamic coefficients, dynamic pressure, center of gravity, center of pressure, and velocity, 5 inputs, 2 outputs, {Force axes} sets Coordinate system for aerodynamic force; {Input axes} sets the coordinate system for input coefficients, {Moment axes} sets the coordinate system for aerodynamic moment, {Reference area}, {Reference span} and {Reference length}. Values come from the instance.
